historicalSportData.name: Liga Aficionada (historically attested terminology; exact official title unverified)
historicalSportData.known: El Gráfico interview 2020: referee Ramón Migdonio Argueta began in Liga Aficionada in 1991 before moving to Liga Mayor B, Liga de Ascenso and Primera in 1996/97. El Gráfico historical survey 2016 records 1996 professional tiers as 10, 36 and 60 clubs respectively; ADFA restructuring later. Diario El Salvador 2021 dates creation of ADFA to legislative decree 529 of 2001-08-30. Amateur tier below professional third is historically supported; specific OG fourth division mapping remains provisional. Do not backdate ADFA modern rules.
